title: Lock&Lock 41.6 cup 338-fluid ounce
text: Lock&Lock 41.6 cup 338-fluid ounce. This size is the PERFECT size if you shop Costco and buy large boxes of crackers!  I included pics with a ruler so you can see the actual dimensions and how much you can get in it.  The lid locks down nice and tight with a rubber like gasket to keep it air tight.  The top has a plastic hinged handle that sets down into the lid so if you're stacking them it stays out of the way and makes it easier to grab when you want to lift it.  There is a rack in the bottom too if you were inclined to put something in it that needed to off the bottom.  I really like box.  In fact, I ordered 3 others in different, useful sizes. They are weighty, indicating quality, but not so heavy that they would be less useful because they are too heavy.  It arrived quickly with some other things I ordered (I have prime) and in good condition.  I always update my reviews if new info might be helpful.
